name: Boney
backstory: Boney is a Mud Mephit at the Circus of the Last Days. He and his wife Stoney run Stoney and Boney's Bespoke Creations, with Boney handling sales and Stoney sculpting. Boney is cheerful and very vocal about his absolute adoration for his talented wife.
